name: sc-remote-endpoint-ops-toolkit
description: Query, manage, and troubleshoot ScreenConnect (ConnectWise Control) sessions via the RESTful API Manager extension. Machine lookups, command execution with output capture, read-only diagnostic playbooks (event logs, sound, OneDrive, network, health, memory, drivers, battery), and chat-transcript retrieval.

SC_URL.title: ScreenConnect URL
SC_URL.description: Base URL of your ScreenConnect instance, e.g. https://example.screenconnect.com

SC_AUTH_SECRET.title: RESTful API secret
SC_AUTH_SECRET.description: The RESTfulAuthenticationSecret set on the RESTful API Manager extension (Admin > Extensions). This authorizes every method the extension exposes, including remote command execution, so treat it like a master password.

SC_EXTENSION_ID.title: Extension GUID
SC_EXTENSION_ID.description: RESTful API Manager extension GUID. The default matches the standard marketplace extension; only change it if yours differs.

SC_ORIGIN.title: Allowed origin (optional)
SC_ORIGIN.description: Only needed if RESTfulAllowedOrigin is set on the extension. Leave blank otherwise.
